title: AI based Virtual Yoga Instructor for Good health
summary: C-DAC presents an active yoga-instruction demo that aims to make posture guidance affordable; practitioner health effects are not quantified.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: The virtual instructor uses AI to recognize yoga poses and provide feedback. C-DAC lists an active demonstration and plans a wider pose dataset and mobile application. Its proposed benefits include accessible exercise guidance and preventive health education, without a reported fitness or health improvement.
purpose: Make yoga instruction and posture feedback more accessible.
developer: Centre for Development of Advanced Computing, Pune

ratings.reason: An active yoga demo is described, but no practitioner health or fitness outcome is reported.
Population health and pandemic resilience are anticipated benefits.

ai_role.statement: The account does not isolate AI’s contribution from the surrounding workflow.

evidence.citation: International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025). Project-submitted account, current as of June 2025. ITU provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 2: AI based Virtual Yoga Instructor for Good health

produced_by: The account does not establish conditions sufficient to reproduce the benefit.
must_hold: The account does not establish requirements for reproducing the benefit in other settings.

headline: A virtual yoga instructor offers automated posture feedback
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
